parameters.content:
KENDALIKU | MyControl — WAHA inbound AMAN
Jalur WAHA nyata: WAHA session default -> webhook n8n (Header Auth) -> normalize/filter -> Supabase mc_ingest_whatsapp -> ACK 200.
JANGAN jalankan workflow inbound lama atau WAHA Trigger lain secara bersamaan.
Bukti transfer/lampiran tidak otomatis disetujui. Simpan identitas event dan raw payload.
WAHA Trigger community tidak dipakai di jalur ini agar ACK dan Header Auth tetap terjaga.

nodes.name: WAHA Incoming Webhook
nodes.notes: Set Header Auth credential: X-MyControl-Secret. Configure identical WAHA webhook custom header. No secret in JSON.

meta.activation: OFF. Configure Header Auth and WAHA webhook. Do not run alongside legacy inbound.
